title: build(deps): bump vue from 3.5.43 to 3.5.44
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. vue 3.5.43 -> 3.5.44 in packages/client (patch release, 2026-10-13, bug fixes only: compiler v-html constant stringification of 0/false, v-memo key guard, v-show transition, reactivity watcher/iterator/shallow-collection fixes, runtime-core prop-key and scheduler fixes, KeepAlive/Suspense/Teleport/Transition fixes). Moves the @vue/* family in lockstep AND four transitive packages the title does not name -- see behavior_change. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001). The Dependabot commit also flipped `peer: true` on 16 entries (13 with unchanged versions, plus the peer key on vue, postcss and @vue/compiler-dom); per main's convention since #432 (ec88eedd) that churn is dropped so the diff is the bump only.
behavior_change: Lockfile audited against merge base 2e2d635f by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry in full. Entries 400 -> 400, added=0, removed=0. Fourteen node_modules entries moved: vue and @vue/{compiler-core, compiler-dom, compiler-sfc, compiler-ssr, reactivity, runtime-core, runtime-dom, server-renderer, shared} 3.5.43 -> 3.5.44 in lockstep; plus four transitive movements NOT named in the PR title: postcss 8.5.28 -> 8.5.30, nanoid 3.3.18 -> 3.3.20 (postcss dependency), source-map-js 1.2.1 -> 1.2.2, @babel/parser 7.29.8 -> 7.29.9. The postcss move is forced, not incidental: @vue/compiler-sfc 3.5.44 raised its postcss range from ^8.5.28 to ^8.5.29 (npm view), so the hoisted postcss 8.5.28 no longer satisfies it. This overlaps sibling PR #449 (postcss 8.5.28 -> 8.5.30 devDependency range bump): both resolve postcss to the identical 8.5.30 entry, so the move is forward and consistent, not a #296-shaped revert. Every `dependencies` map that changed was checked key by key: same key sets, only version-range movements. The root entry differs in one key, dependencies.vue ^3.5.43 -> ^3.5.44; the declared devDependency postcss range stays ^8.5.28 (still satisfied by 8.5.30). Runtime: vue is the framework, so every route is affected; 3.5.44 is a bug-fix patch. The one fix that touches a directive the app uses heavily, v-html (about 20 SFCs), changes only compile-time stringification of constant literals 0/false; the app binds HTML/SVG strings, so output is unchanged. postcss/nanoid/source-map-js/@babel/parser are build-time (SFC compile, CSS) with no runtime footprint in the bundle beyond compiled output.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves the declared vue range ^3.5.43 -> ^3.5.44 -- one line. package-lock.json resolves vue + nine @vue/* packages 3.5.43 -> 3.5.44 and four transitive build-time packages (postcss 8.5.30, nanoid 3.3.20, source-map-js 1.2.2, @babel/parser 7.29.9). Dependabot's peer-flag churn reverted to the merge-base values.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency. No existing manifest covers this diff; borrowing an older one is what CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 refuses. The postcss overlap with #449 is declared here rather than left for a reviewer to discover.
